# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 112 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 112 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_112_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 10, Chapter 2

**1** "But when the tower is completed, what then?" I asked. **2** "Ask about this also," he answered. "But when the tower is finished, then comes the end." **3** "But the testing of the righteous — when shall that be?" "It shall be always; for it has been appointed for them by the Lord God." **4** "Lord," I said, "is there hope for those who were rejected from the tower?" **5** "There is," he said, "but this is their penance: they shall dwell by the tower and be wept over and tortured; and if they do not repent, then they shall be given entirely to the women who carry the black garments, and they shall be tormented by them." **6** "But what if they repent? Will they then enter the tower?" **7** "Not before the tower is completed," he answered. **8** "But I want to know how the tower will be completed," I said. **9** "When the Lord judges all things and there is found no more unrighteousness in the chosen people of God — then the tower shall be completed." **10** I said to him, "Lord, when will this be?" "It will be," he said, "when the Lord has ordered all things and they have been brought to completion." **11** "But what about the virgins?" I asked. "Must they remain with the tower always?" **12** "Until the tower is complete," he said, "they shall be needed; but when it is complete, they shall depart and go away." **13** "And the angels who helped build the tower — shall they go too?" **14** "They shall go," he said, "but first the tower shall be completed. Then all shall rejoice together in the presence of God."

---

*EMET: the eschatological sequence: tower completion → judgment → no unrighteousness found → the end. The virgins (virtues) depart when the Church is perfected — virtue will no longer be needed as a striving but will be the natural condition.*
